ruleRoutingGuidance.belongs: agent-maintained market, user and competitor research wikis — cited pages, growth logs, the reviewed product-requirements sink
ruleRoutingGuidance.excludes: how the product is built or specced — that is spec-driven-product; requirement proofs are executable-requirements

questions.prompt: What is the product — what does it do, and what is the core value it delivers? If the repo already carries a product brief or spec, read it and confirm rather than asking cold.
questions.distill: recorded as intent on this entry (the pack takes no config); it names what the research is about and frames every seeded wiki

questions.prompt: Who are the users or customers — the segments whose needs the research must track?
questions.distill: recorded as intent; scopes the user-research wiki and whose problems the findings answer to

questions.prompt: What market or category is this in, and who are the main competitors or alternatives? This is what the competitor research is scoped against.
questions.distill: recorded as intent; names the competitor set the initial competitor-landscape wiki is seeded from
